previewInstallSurfaceNote: CHOSEN MODEL (lands CLAUDE-G08H-V1-B1): one surface model, cardinality 3. previewInstallSurfaces is the machine axis TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT. Those three are the v8 roles marked in G08 install scope and the only lawful values of the v8 audit shape's role field for this harness. There is no fourth peer install surface. This specification does not invent TR-ROOT. The file-08 / naming-v6 phrase root/index/core/component install trust is scope prose (scopeRiderVerbatim; claimAndCellCarriedThenScoped); it is not an enumerated evidence axis. The file-08 words index/core/component map 1:1 onto TR-INDEX/TR-CORE/TR-COMPONENT. The file-08 word Root is discharged inside each of those three roles by the accepted-anchor records and the air-gap root-chain records named at file08RootWordDischarge. Roles do not share a single collapsed state. A CORE expiry is not an INDEX expiry. A CORE accepted-anchor is not an INDEX accepted-anchor. v8 offlineRunningPolicy.precedence remains Evaluate CORE first, then INDEX, then COMPONENT — that is continue-decision order, not a fourth surface. TR-BUNDLE is named in v8 and is not a required preview shipping surface. TR-REPAIR is named in v8 and deferred with DR-110.

retainedEvidence.measures: Append-only signed history of install-trust metadata for each machine-axis surface (TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT; cardinality 3), including that role's accepted-anchor records and air-gap root-chain records (file08RootWordDischarge): accepted snapshots, revocation observations, expiry and future-time observations, quorum observations, first-install attempts, and anti-rollback counters. History is distinct from executable generation pointers. There is no fourth history column.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform, per connectivity class (online, offline, air-gap, removable-media), and per machine-axis surface (TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT; cardinality 3), a digest-pinned history whose records are the v8 audit shape { role, from, to, event, outcome: accepted|refused, refusalReason?, payloadDigests, clockObservation }. The audit role field is exactly one of TR-INDEX, TR-CORE, TR-COMPONENT; it is never root and never TR-ROOT. The file-08 word Root is discharged inside each role's history by (1) accepted-anchor records — TRUSTED-entry / accepted-snapshot / recovery records that apply v8 bootstrapAnchorCustody (the presented root is the install-scoped accepted anchor for this role) or, on EV-RECOVER-COMMIT, v8 recoveryAuthorityShape (oldRootIdentification, oldRootNewRootRoleBinding, newRootDoesNotSelfAuthorize); ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED means no accepted root/index snapshot for this role — and (2) air-gap root-chain records — payloadDigests covering the v8 airGapPayload.mustCarry member root chain on air-gap/removable-media PRESENT for this same role. A missing root-chain is a missing payload member (refuse, no fetch). There is no fourth history column. The history contains distinct records for install-trust expiry (EV-CLOCK to ST-EXPIRED, including future-metadata refuse), revocation (EV-REVOKE to ST-REVOKED, including last-known revocation advance), quorum loss (EV-QUORUM-OBSERVE to ST-QUORUM-LOST; the reserved threshold is named, not minted), and first-install refusal (ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED EV-INSTALL or incomplete/inactive ordinary PRESENT). Anti-rollback / last-known-revocation counters in the history never decrease because an executable generation rolled back. Stale last-known revocation (ST-STALE-REVOCATION; freshness floor reserved as OD-112-2) is recorded when observed; the floor is not minted. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Each of the four naming-v6 executes limbs appears as its own history records. Partial understand of expired or future metadata is absent. Executable rollback does not rewrite, delete, or reverse those records or counters. Roles are not collapsed. A CORE accepted-anchor is not an INDEX accepted-anchor. There is no fourth (root) column. Pass all four platforms, all four connectivity classes, and all three machine-axis surfaces (TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT).
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: online/offline/air-gap/removable-media corpus classes, signed-history limb. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: Install-trust recovery after expiry, after revocation, and after quorum loss, including root-recovery ceremony shape for the install-scoped accepted anchor. Ordinary air-gap/removable-media refresh from EXPIRED / STALE-REVOCATION / QUORUM-LOST is recovery of those conditions, not a collapsed 'trust'.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform, per connectivity class, and per machine-axis surface (TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT; cardinality 3), recovery records for each of expiry, revocation, and quorum loss. Root-recovery is the install-scoped accepted-anchor recovery for that role (v8 recoveryCeremony; recoveryAuthorityShape oldRootIdentification, oldRootNewRootRoleBinding, newRootDoesNotSelfAuthorize; bootstrapAnchorCustody is not applied to a replacement root). It is not a fourth surface. Ordinary complete payload from EXPIRED/STALE-REVOCATION/QUORUM-LOST may enter ST-TRUSTED only when TRUSTED-entry is ACTIVE and v8 requiredOnEveryTrustedEntry holds; while INACTIVE the audit refusalReason is ENVELOPE-INACTIVE. Recovery-typed payload from UNBOOTSTRAPPED/EXPIRED/STALE-REVOCATION/QUORUM-LOST/REVOKED stages only and does not enter ST-TRUSTED via EV-PRESENT-PAYLOAD. EV-RECOVER-BEGIN -> ST-RECOVERY; EV-RECOVER-COMMIT -> ST-TRUSTED only when recoveryTrustedEntry holds (numbers reserved); EV-RECOVER-ABORT is accepted, publishes no root, and never restores ST-TRUSTED by silence. Ceremony shape is v8 recoveryCeremony; quorum size, participant list, break-glass officer, and waiver duration are not minted. First-install refusal is not this member (EV-3). Repair-media / self-update recovery is not this member (DR-110). Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Expiry, revocation, and quorum-loss each have a recovery path that either reaches ST-TRUSTED only through the consumed v8 refresh/ceremony path with counters advanced, or stays non-TRUSTED with an audited refusal. Abort does not restore TRUSTED. First-install is not scored here. Repair-media is not scored here. Pass all four platforms, all four connectivity classes, and all three machine-axis surfaces (TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT).
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: air-gap and removable-media corpus classes (recovery limb); online/offline observation of the same recovery states. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: Typed audited refusal of new install-trust admission: first-install from UNBOOTSTRAPPED, and new admission after expiry, revocation, or quorum loss. Every attempted event that refuses leaves an operational-metadata audit record. This is not sealed evidence.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform, per connectivity class, and per machine-axis surface (TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT; cardinality 3), refusal-audit bytes for all four naming-v6 executes limbs: (1) first-install refusal — ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED + EV-INSTALL => INSTALL-NOT-TRUSTED; incomplete ordinary payload => PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE; TRUSTED-entry INACTIVE on an applicable ordinary PRESENT => ENVELOPE-INACTIVE; (2) expiry — ST-EXPIRED + EV-INSTALL refuses INSTALL-NOT-TRUSTED; expired or future metadata is not partially understood; (3) revocation — ST-REVOKED + EV-INSTALL refuses INSTALL-NOT-TRUSTED; (4) quorum loss — ST-QUORUM-LOST + EV-INSTALL refuses INSTALL-NOT-TRUSTED. Each refused record has outcome=refused, to==from, and a refusalReason from the v8 vocabulary. Accepted events including EV-RECOVER-ABORT omit refusalReason. Newly-revoked replay, if presented, is CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED riding DR-113 — a typed refusal of an undesigned continue, not a designed replay and not a fifth executes limb. OD-112-3 emergency continue of a REVOKED component remains RESERVED; preview refuse. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: First-install refusal, expiry refusal, revocation refusal, and quorum-loss refusal each retain audit bytes. A refused event without refusalReason fails. An accepted event carrying refusalReason fails. Replay is not designed here. Pass all four platforms, all four connectivity classes, and all three machine-axis surfaces (TR-INDEX / TR-CORE / TR-COMPONENT).
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: online/offline/air-gap/removable-media corpus classes, refusal-audit limb. Not authored.
